text: 🇲🇽⚽ The 2026 World Cup is over. Sheinbaum's closing verdict: Mexico was the best host. "Felicidades a todas y todos los mexicanos por hacer de México la mejor sede, y a nuestra Selección Nacional por el gran papel que desempeñó, poniendo en alto el nombre de nuestro país con entrega, talento y orgullo." "Congratulations to all Mexicans for making Mexico the best host, and to our National Team for the great role it played, raising our country's name with dedication, talent and pride." — Claudia Sheinbaum, after the final in New York, July 19, 2026 Spain beat Argentina to take the title. Mexico co-hosted the tournament with the U.S. and Canada, staging matches in Mexico City, Guadalajara and Monterrey.

🇲🇽✊ "Mexicanas y mexicanos trabajadores, los quiere y admira todo México." "Gracias por recibirme con tanto cariño… Son más que correspondidos. Mexicanas y mexicanos trabajadores, los quiere y admira todo México." "Thank you for receiving me with such affection… It's more than reciprocated. Working Mexican women and men — all of Mexico loves and admires you." — Claudia Sheinbaum, thanking the Mexican community on arriving in New York She landed in New York for the World Cup final and thanked the Mexican community that welcomed her — the largest immigrant population in the United States.

🇲🇽🌎 Three host nations, one stage. "Consideré que es importante en términos diplomáticos que estemos los tres países que fuimos sedes de esta Copa del Mundo y además es una muestra de que hay buena coordinación, buena colaboración con el gobierno de los Estados Unidos." "I considered it important, diplomatically, that the three countries that hosted this World Cup be present — and it's a sign that there is good coordination, good collaboration with the U.S. government." — Claudia Sheinbaum, on attending the final at Trump's invitation, alongside Canadian PM Mark Carney

🇲🇽⚽ Mexico co-hosted the 2026 World Cup. Sheinbaum went to the final to represent it. "Así que vamos a representar a México el día de mañana y estaremos el lunes temprano en la Ciudad de México." "So we are going to represent Mexico tomorrow, and we'll be back in Mexico City early Monday." — Claudia Sheinbaum, on attending the 2026 World Cup final Mexico, the United States and Canada jointly hosted the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Sheinbaum attended the final at the New York–New Jersey stadium and returned to Mexico City the following morning.

🇲🇽💵 REMITTANCES TO MEXICO CLIMB 2.8% — TRUMP'S CRACKDOWN CAN'T STOP THE FLOW

Mexico took in $25,287 million in remittances from January to May, up 2.8% year-on-year, with May alone hitting $5,611 million — a 3.8% jump, per Banxico (via El Financiero). It's the recovery after 2025's first annual decline in 11 years, and it comes despite Washington's new remittance tax and mass-deportation drive. Mexican workers abroad keep sending home more, not less.

🇲🇽🏥 MEXICO IS DOUBLING ITS PUBLIC HEALTH CLINICS — 500 NEW ISSSTE OFFICES NATIONWIDE

ISSSTE director Martí Batres announced 500 new primary-care clinics — 200 this year, 300 across the term — doubling the network and reaching 13.9 million beneficiaries. Each is staffed with doctors, nurses and free basic medicine, built to catch illness before it becomes an ER emergency. While the US debates who deserves healthcare, Mexico is building it.

🚨🇲🇽 FOUR CIA AGENTS DIED IN A CHIHUAHUA CRASH — RUNNING OPS MEXICO NEVER AUTHORIZED

Contralínea details an April 19 accident in Chihuahua that killed four CIA officers and two state investigators — agents conducting clandestine field intelligence on Mexican soil without federal authorization. Analyst Nayar López Castellanos: "The CIA is one of the primary spy apparatuses the United States has, designed to structure this imperialist power for decades." Building informant networks inside Mexican institutions isn't cooperation.

🔥🇲🇽 US POURED $820 MILLION INTO MEXICAN "PARTNERS" — THEN SHEINBAUM TURNED OFF THE TAP

A Contralínea investigation found Washington's INL bureau channeled $819.8 million into Mexican prosecutors' offices, NGOs and universities between 2019 and 2024 — money to "improve partner countries' capacity to cooperate with US law enforcement." The funding collapsed from $232.4 million in 2019 to $47.6 million in 2024, the first year under Sheinbaum. Sovereignty isn't a slogan; it's refusing the check that buys your justice system.

🚨🇲🇽 2,529 MIGRANTS VANISHED ON THE ROAD TO THE US — WASHINGTON CALLS IT "BORDER SECURITY"

The Argentine Forensic Anthropology Team has logged 2,529 reports of migrants disappeared along the Mexico-US corridor since 2010, and recovered just 482 bodies. The IOM counts more than 6,600 dead or missing on the land border in a single decade. Every wall, every deportation flight, every ICE raid pushes people onto deadlier routes — this is the human cost of the "secure border" the empire sells.

🔥🇲🇽 EX-PAN GOVERNOR RUFFO HAULED TO MAXIMUM-SECURITY PRISON OVER $4 BILLION FUEL RACKET

A judge ordered Ernesto Ruffo Appel — Baja California's first PAN governor — and seven accomplices into pretrial detention at the Altiplano after a 40-hour hearing. The FGR traced 3,075 million pesos through 80 bank accounts and $1,386 million dollars in currency operations tied to the Ingemar smuggling network, which drained an estimated 4 billion pesos from the treasury in just six months of 2025. The party that lectured Mexico on "law and order" ran an industrial-scale huachicol operation.
